subject: Sprint 28 commit proof and source-state verification

bundle_git_log_discrepancy.explanation: Sprint 28 bundle git-log-proof.txt captured git log BEFORE the final commit 20686d3. The bundle was built during the sprint, staged, and committed — the bundle itself is inside commit 20686d3. The git log inside the bundle necessarily cannot reference the commit that adds the bundle itself.
bundle_git_log_discrepancy.resolution: Sprint 29 git-log-proof.txt starts from 20686d3, proving Sprint 28 commit exists and is HEAD
